prompt: Which statements about Redis Cloud REST API user keys are correct? (Select three.)
explanation: A user key is a personal secret that belongs to exactly one user, though one user may hold several keys; it is issued to users with the Owner, Viewer, Billing admin, or Logs viewer role, and it can be restricted to defined source IP ranges with a CIDR allow list. The full key value is shown only during creation, so capture it at generation time. Keys are not shared account-wide, and the account key is always required alongside the user key for every request.

options.text: A user key belongs to exactly one user, although a user may hold several keys
User keys are issued to users holding the Owner, Viewer, Billing admin, or Logs viewer role
One shared user key is assigned to all users of the account
A user key can be limited to requests from defined IP ranges with a CIDR allow list
Requests authenticate with the user key alone when the account key is omitted
